item.title: Food prices spike: Nigerians witness 400% rise in a decade
item.description: AN analysis of select staple food prices between January 2016 and October 2025 by The ICIR shows that the cost of basic food items, namely rice, beans, garri, bread, eggs, and yams grew by over 413 per cent. These increases span two administrations – the late former President Muhammadu Buhari and the incumbent Bola Tinubu.
